title: No Glow Ink Sacs
description: Removes glow ink sacs and replaces their uses with glowstone dust
body:
This mod replaces all uses of glow ink sacs with glowstone dust. 

This includes recipes and making signs glow. 
In addition, glow ink squids will now drop regular ink sacs instead of glow ink sacs.

This is useful when you feel that glow-ink sacs are a redundant addition to the game that takes up niche that belongs to glowstone dust.

---

**You may freely use this mod in any modpack, as long as the download remains hosted within the Modrinth ecosystem.**
